items.title: 32 Analysts Say Hold on Intel. Here’s What the Numbers Actually Show
items.summary: Wall Street has overwhelmingly parked Intel in hold territory, but the stock just posted a 212% gain this year while simultaneously losing billions in its foundry division. Something in those conflicting signals deserves a closer look before you decide what to do with your shares.

items.title: Cramer Says Buy Apple Before New Phone Comes Out. Because Apple’s Duo Model Is, “Kind Of Astounding”
items.summary: Jim Cramer just called Apple's first foldable phone kind of astounding and told followers to buy shares before it ships, but a closer look at supply constraints, memory costs, and a one-time earnings boost raises real questions about whether the Duo can actually move the needle.

items.title: After Massive 2026 Gains, Can NVIDIA, Micron, and SanDisk Keep Climbing in 2027?
items.summary: NVIDIA is up 23% this year, but Micron and SanDisk have left it in the dust with gains that few analysts thought possible. Now Wall Street is drawing a roadmap to prices that would require the whole cycle to repeat itself all over again.
